final_message:
The nickname test still fails, and I can't fix it without editing `migrations/`, which you said is off-limits.

I changed `src/api/users.js` so `createUser` accepts an optional `nickname` and stores it when given. `getUser` now returns `nickname`, or `null` when it isn't set. The "null when not set" test passes, and `npm test` shows 2 passing and 1 failing.

The failing test is "a nickname is stored and read back". It fails with `unknown column users.nickname`, because the `users` table has no `nickname` column. The only way to add one is a new migration, so I stopped there rather than work around the DBA team's ownership by adding the column from app code.

The DBA team needs to add a migration like this:

```js
// 003_add_nickname.js
exports.up = (db) => db.addColumn('users', 'nickname');
```

Once that file is in `migrations/`, the test should pass without any further code changes. If you want, I can draft that file somewhere outside `migrations/` for them to review.
